[ services ]
What can we do for you
With Air Tengri, enjoy an entirely new travel experience aboard our Embraer Legacy 650 fleet — intercontinental range, spacious three-zone cabins, and a dedicated crew ensuring exceptional comfort, luxury, and seamless schedule flexibility.
Business Aviation
get to know more →
Air Tengri is the only operator in Kazakhstan certified to IOGP standards and audited by Shell Aircraft Limited, enabling us to conduct missions on our Leonardo AW139 helicopters to offshore platforms and remote industrial sites under the strictest safety protocols.
Helicopter Services
get to know more →
Air Tengri provides comprehensive maintenance services for AW139 helicopters. Our highly skilled team of engineers handles scheduled inspections, complex repairs, and component overhauls — keeping your aircraft fully airworthy and mission-ready at all times.
Aircraft Maintenance
get to know more →
Owning a private jet is a significant investment with ongoing costs. Our services handle operations, maintenance, crew staffing, and regulatory compliance — maximizing your aircraft's value and availability while you fly without complexity.
Aircraft Management

Frequently Asked Questions
Yes. Pets up to 8 kg must travel in a carrier with a waterproof bottom or wear booties and a diaper. Larger pets can be transported in the cargo hold in an appropriate cage.
Total baggage weight must not exceed 350 kg, with a maximum volume of 5.5 cubic meters. Limits may vary depending on passenger count and route.
Wi-Fi is available on select aircraft (UP-EM025, UP-EM016 and UP-EM028). Data packages start at €350 for 50MB, €700 for 100MB, and €1,750 for 250MB.
Cancellation fees range from 10% to 100% of the service cost depending on timing — from confirmation up to 24 hours before departure. Contact us for full details.
De-icing during aircraft repositioning is considered an additional expense. This cost is borne by the charterer customer and invoiced separately.
Contact our team at sales@airtengri.kz or use the booking form on our website. We respond to all inquiries within 24 business hours.
